sensitive-lakeshore-polygons.geojson.query: where 1=1, geometry = WBD HUC8 07010102 polygon, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects
sensitive-lakeshore-polygons.geojson.caveats: DNR Sensitive Lakeshore Highly Sensitive Shoreland (layer 1) -- high-score shoreline clusters buffered by 1/4 mile, per the 2010 report method. This service IS the GIS of the 2010 Thompson & Perleberg model output (checked 2026-11-21). Leech Lake's five sensitive areas come as ONE multipart polygon per lake (sens_acres 13,078.86), NOT five separately named features -- the viewer cannot label 'Area 1...5' from this file; the 2010 report PDF (Fig. 76) remains the source for the five-area framing and names. `analysis` separates 'Full' from 'Abbreviated' (rapid-assessment) lakes; carry the field so the viewer can label/filter them. `sens_acres` is the FULL-feature value; edge-lake polygons are clipped to the HUC8 boundary, so drawn area can be smaller. Loon nesting areas and plant beds are PDF-only and are NOT in this file. Feature count matches the live returnCountOnly count.
